nodes.label: mysqld_main
nodes.desc: Server entry point: init storage engines and enter the connection loop.

nodes.label: Connection_handler_manager
nodes.desc: process_new_connection routes accepted sockets to a handler policy.

nodes.label: Protocol_classic::get_command
nodes.desc: Reads one packet off the wire and decodes the COM_* command byte.

nodes.label: dispatch_command
nodes.desc: Switches on the command byte; COM_QUERY flows into dispatch_sql_command and mysql_execute_command.

nodes.label: lex_one_token
nodes.desc: Hand-written lexer feeding the bison grammar one token at a time.

nodes.label: JOIN::optimize
nodes.desc: Chooses join order, access methods and temp-table strategies per query block.

nodes.label: CreateIteratorFromAccessPath
nodes.desc: Compiles the declarative access-path tree into a composition of RowIterators.

nodes.label: Query_expression::ExecuteIteratorQuery
nodes.desc: Root of iterator execution: initializes and drains the iterator tree.

nodes.label: TableScanIterator::DoRead
nodes.desc: Leaf iterator pulling rows from one table via the handler API.

nodes.label: AggregateIterator::DoRead
nodes.desc: Streaming GROUP BY / aggregate wrapper over a child iterator.

nodes.label: handler::ha_index_read_map
nodes.desc: Engine-agnostic index lookup wrapper that forwards to the storage engine.

nodes.label: handler::ha_write_row
nodes.desc: Insert wrapper that forwards to the engine after bookkeeping checks.

nodes.label: ha_commit_trans
nodes.desc: Two-phase commit coordinator across binlog and participating engines.

nodes.label: ha_innobase::general_fetch
nodes.desc: InnoDB side of row reads; keeps a prebuilt fetch structure per handle.

nodes.label: ha_innobase::write_row
nodes.desc: Converts a MySQL row to InnoDB tuple and enters the insert path.

nodes.label: row_search_mvcc
nodes.desc: The single InnoDB scan/point-read funnel with MVCC visibility filtering.

nodes.label: btr_cur_search_to_nth_level
nodes.desc: Descends the B-tree from root to leaf latching pages along the way.

nodes.label: btr_page_split_and_insert
nodes.desc: Splits a full B-tree page and re-inserts the tuple.

nodes.label: row_ins_clust_index_entry_low
nodes.desc: Inserts one entry into the clustered index, splitting if needed.

nodes.label: buf_page_get_gen
nodes.desc: Locates or reads a page into the buffer pool and returns a latched block.

nodes.label: buf_LRU_free_page
nodes.desc: Evicts a clean victim page when the free list runs low.

nodes.label: buf_flush_page_and_try_neighbors
nodes.desc: Page-cleaner write-behind for dirty pages, batching neighbors.

nodes.label: mtr_t::commit
nodes.desc: Publishes all changes of one mini-transaction into the redo log buffer.

nodes.label: log_writer_write_buffer
nodes.desc: Dedicated log writer thread copying contiguous LSN ranges to disk.

nodes.label: Log_checkpointing::log_checkpointer
nodes.desc: Background thread advancing the redo checkpoint and bounding recovery.

nodes.label: trx_commit
nodes.desc: Finalizes the InnoDB transaction: undo state, commit record, lock release.

nodes.label: MVCC::view_open
nodes.desc: Opens a ReadView snapshot listing active transactions for consistency.

nodes.label: lock_rec_lock
nodes.desc: Acquires record locks; queues waiters on conflicting holders.

nodes.label: Deadlock_notifier::notify
nodes.desc: Walks wait-for cycles and picks a victim to roll back.

nodes.label: MYSQL_BIN_LOG::commit
nodes.desc: TC_LOG entry point caching events and entering group commit.

nodes.label: MYSQL_BIN_LOG::ordered_commit
nodes.desc: flush/sync/commit stages with change_stage queues serializing each stage.

nodes.label: Binlog_sender::run
nodes.desc: Dump thread streaming binlog events to connected replicas.

nodes.label: handle_slave_io
nodes.desc: Replica I/O thread pulling events into the relay log.

nodes.label: handle_slave_sql
nodes.desc: Replica applier thread replaying relay-log transactions.
